text:
maya: FYI PR #4127 landed with the per-route cost breakdown dashboard snippet but I noticed two problems: the Python example is missing and one of the internal links 404s.
ben: which link is 404? can you paste it here?
maya: https://docs.redwood.ai/obs/dashboards/per-route#cost-breakdown -> returns 404 for the fragment. the markdown in the snippet points to it.
sam: I can add a Python wrapper for the snippet. what level of detail do we want? tiny usage example or full integration with the SDK client?
maya: small usage example that mirrors the Node sample: show client init, attach trace context, and call get_route_costs(). 2–3 lines plus a brief note about batching.
alejandra: also check param rename: we switched from `route_id` to `route` in the SDK last quarter. some of the docs still use the old name — PR should update the snippet to the new API.
ben: good catch. if we change the snippet we should also update the code block caption and the inline code example in the quickstart. want me to open a follow-up PR for captions?
sam: I'll push a small commit to #4127 with a Python snippet and the param rename. quick draft below — feel free to tweak:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
# fetch per-route cost for recent window
costs = client.observability.get_route_costs(route="/generate", window="1h")
print(costs.breakdown_by_token)
```
maya: looks good. add a single sentence about expected latency impact when enabling per-route aggregation (it can add ~5ms) so customers are aware.
docs-ci-bot: automated linkcheck failed for docs/per-route: broken fragment detected in docs.redwood.ai (HTTP 404)
sam: thanks, I updated the link to https://docs.redwood.ai/console/observability#per-route-costs in the commit and added the Python snippet. pushed to branch `docs/4127-per-route-snippet`.
ben: can you also run `yarn docs:build` locally and paste the generated anchor so we have confidence the fragment is stable?
sam: done — anchor is `#console-observability-per-route-costs` (different from what the old markdown used). I updated the link and added a short note in the changelog section of the doc.
alejandra: pinging eng-runtime to make sure `get_route_costs` export won't be renamed again in the next patch. @runtime-team?
maya: thanks everyone. merging after CI green and a quick smokecheck in staging. I'll queue the merge and add the manual QA step to the PR checklist. :thumbsup:
